name: hermes-business
description: A friendly always-available business assistant powered by Hermes Agent

scripts.verify:plugin: node scripts/build-plugin.mjs --check && node --check hermes-plugin/business-shell/plugin.js && node scripts/verify-plugin.mjs
scripts.verify:plugin:release: node scripts/build-plugin.mjs --check && node --check hermes-plugin/business-shell/plugin.js && node scripts/verify-plugin.mjs --release
scripts.build: node scripts/build-plugin.mjs && node scripts/verify-plugin.mjs && tsc -b && vite build
scripts.build:qa: node scripts/build-plugin.mjs && node scripts/verify-plugin.mjs && tsc -b && vite build --mode qa
scripts.test:contract: npm run test:plugin:policy && npm run verify:plugin && npm run verify:bootstrap
scripts.test:plugin:policy: python -m unittest discover -s hermes-plugin/business-whatsapp-policy/tests -p test_*.py -v && python -m unittest discover -s hermes-plugin/business-shell/dashboard -p test_*.py -v
scripts.build:test-packaged: npm run build && node scripts/gen-build-attestation.mjs && electron-builder --win dir
scripts.test:e2e:bootstrap-clean: npm run build:plugin && powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/e2e-bootstrap-clean.ps1
scripts.test:e2e:thin-installer: npm run build:plugin && powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/e2e-thin-network-installer.ps1
scripts.package:thin-installer:qa: npm run build:plugin && powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/e2e-thin-network-installer.ps1 -EmitQaArtifact
scripts.verify:release: npm test && npm run test:evidence && npm run test:plugin:policy && npm run verify:plugin:release && npm run verify:bootstrap
scripts.package:win: npm run verify:release && npm run build && node scripts/gen-build-attestation.mjs && electron-builder --win dir && node scripts/finalize-payload.mjs --channel public && electron-builder --prepackaged release/win-unpacked --win nsis && node scripts/verify-no-update-metadata.mjs release && node scripts/gen-lock-attest.mjs && node scripts/sign-release.mjs --channel public && node scripts/gen-release-report.mjs && node scripts/e2e-exact-artifact.mjs --channel public && node scripts/finalize-release.mjs --channel public
scripts.package:win:qa: npm run verify:release && npm run build:qa && node scripts/gen-build-attestation.mjs && electron-builder --win dir && node scripts/finalize-payload.mjs --channel qa && electron-builder --prepackaged release/win-unpacked --win nsis && node scripts/verify-no-update-metadata.mjs release && node scripts/gen-lock-attest.mjs && node scripts/sign-release.mjs --channel qa && node scripts/gen-release-report.mjs && node scripts/e2e-exact-artifact.mjs --channel qa && node scripts/finalize-release.mjs --channel qa
scripts.package:bootstrap: npm run build:plugin && powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/build-bootstrap.ps1
